description: Charge patterning (kappa), charge-hydropathy, and ELM SLiM scan for RDE-2
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, requests, re, json
seq=open("rde2_Q19672.fasta").read().split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","")
# --- Das-Pappu kappa ---
def charge_vec(s): return np.array([1 if c in "KR" else (-1 if c in "DE" else 0) for c in s],float)
def delta(s,w):
    q=charge_vec(s); n=len(s)
    fp=(q>0).mean(); fm=(q<0).mean(); sig=((fp-fm)**2)/(fp+fm) if (fp+fm)>0 else 0
    ds=[]
    for i in range(n-w+1):
        sub=q[i:i+w]; p=(sub>0).mean(); m=(sub<0).mean()
        s_i=((p-m)**2)/(p+m) if (p+m)>0 else 0
        ds.append((s_i-sig)**2)
    return np.mean(ds)
def kappa(s, nperm=600, seed=0):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(seed)
    if sum(1 for c in s if c in "KRDE")<2: return None
    d=(delta(s,5)+delta(s,6))/2
    arr=list(s); best=0
    # approximate delta_max by many random shuffles keeping charge seq extremes: use segregated arrangement
    pos=[c for c in s if c in "KR"]; neg=[c for c in s if c in "DE"]; neu=[c for c in s if c not in "KRDE"]
    seg="".join(pos)+"".join(neu)+"".join(neg)
    dmax=(delta(seg,5)+delta(seg,6))/2
    return d/dmax if dmax>0 else None
def f(s,a): return sum(s.count(c) for c in a)/len(s)
KD=dict(zip("AVLIPFMWGSTCYNQDEKRH",[1.8,4.2,3.8,4.5,-1.6,2.8,1.9,-0.9,-0.4,-0.8,-0.7,2.5,-1.3,-3.5,-3.5,-3.5,-3.5,-3.9,-4.5,-3.2]))
def H(s): return np.mean([(KD[c]+4.5)/9 for c in s])

regions={"RDE-2 N-PLD 1-45":seq[0:45],"RDE-2 IDR 216-294":seq[215:294],"RDE-2 IDR 297-350":seq[296:350],
         "RDE-2 full":seq}
print(f"{'region':22s} {'len':>4s} {'FCR':>6s} {'NCPR':>7s} {'kappa':>7s} {'<H>':>6s} {'FWY':>6s} {'Y':>6s} {'QN':>6s}")
rows=[]
for k,s in regions.items():
    kp=kappa(s)
    print(f"{k:22s} {len(s):4d} {f(s,'KRDE'):6.3f} {f(s,'KR')-f(s,'DE'):+7.3f} {('%.3f'%kp) if kp else '   n/a':>7s} {H(s):6.3f} {f(s,'FWY'):6.3f} {f(s,'Y'):6.3f} {f(s,'QN'):6.3f}")
    rows.append((k,len(s),f(s,'KRDE'),f(s,'KR')-f(s,'DE'),kp,H(s),f(s,'FWY'),f(s,'Y'),f(s,'QN')))

# Uversky charge-hydropathy boundary: <H> = (<|NCPR|> + 1.151)/2.785
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5))
xs=np.linspace(0,0.6,50); ax[0].plot((xs+1.151)/2.785, xs, 'k--', label="Uversky order/disorder boundary")
cols=["#d69e2e","#2b6cb0","#2c5282","#718096"]
for (k,l,fcr,ncpr,kp,h,fwy,y,qn),c in zip(rows,cols):
    ax[0].scatter(h,abs(ncpr),s=90,color=c,label=k)
ax[0].set_xlabel("mean normalised hydropathy <H>"); ax[0].set_ylabel("|NCPR|")
ax[0].set_title("Charge-hydropathy (Uversky) plot"); ax[0].legend(fontsize=8); ax[0].set_xlim(0.2,0.65)
labels=[r[0] for r in rows[:3]]
ax[1].bar(np.arange(3)-0.2,[r[7] for r in rows[:3]],0.4,label="Tyr fraction",color="#b7791f")
ax[1].bar(np.arange(3)+0.2,[r[8] for r in rows[:3]],0.4,label="Gln+Asn fraction",color="#6b46c1")
ax[1].set_xticks(range(3)); ax[1].set_xticklabels([l.replace("RDE-2 ","") for l in labels],fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_ylabel("fraction"); ax[1].set_title("RDE-2 disordered regions: aromatic and Q/N content"); ax[1].legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# ELM SLiM scan attempt
try:
    t=requests.get("http://elm.eu.org/start_search/Q19672.tsv", timeout=90).text
    open("elm_Q19672.tsv","w").write(t)
    ls=t.strip().split("\n"); print("\nELM hits:",len(ls)-1)
    print("\n".join(ls[:40]))
except Exception as e:
    print("\nELM query failed:", repr(e))
